# Cohort Workspace

## Summary
Tabs: This week (rail + release), Learners (roster + progress + issue), Gradebook (+ docked grader), Attendance, Discussion. Every write is a command; every refusal shown.

## Usage
`<CohortWorkspace @cohort @context @actor @authority />`

## Non-goals
Does not edit the course.
attributes.cardDescription: An instructor's cohort in tabs: this week, learners, gradebook with a docked grader, attendance and discussion, with every write through a command.
